units.source_text: 被灼热的沙子迷住了的眼，使他只感觉到小屋子十分阴暗，冷飕飕、湿漉漉的。

en.t: His eyes, dazzled by the scorching sand, made the little hut seem to him terribly dark, chilly, and damp.

units.source_text: 可他立刻明白那不过是一种错觉。

en.t: But he immediately realized that it was nothing more than an illusion.

units.source_text: 屋子里笼罩着一层发霉的热气，与外面不同。

en.t: Inside the hut, unlike outside, there hung a layer of moldy heat.
